en.bdb: A dissembler cannot create a holy congregation-

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੋਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਚੋਰੀਆਂ ਓੜਕਿ ਦੁਖ ਭਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: chor karai nit choreeaa(n) oRak dhukh bhaaree|

en.bdb: A thief commits thefts daily but ultimnately has to suffer heavily.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਕੁ ਕੰਨੁ ਫੜਿ ਵਢੀਐ ਰਾਵੈ ਪਰਨਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: nak ka(n)n faR vaddeeaai raavai paranaaree|

en.bdb: The ears and nose are chopped of the man who ravishes an other's wife.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਉਘਟ ਰੁਧੇ ਮਿਰਗ ਜਿਉ ਵਿਤੁ ਹਾਰਿ ਜੂਆਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: aaughaT rudhe mirag jiau vit haar jooaaree|

en.bdb: The position of the losing gambler is similar to the deer caught in a trap.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੰਙੀ ਕੁਹਲਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਪਰ ਵੇਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: la(n)n(g)ee kuhal na aaviee par vel piaaree|

en.bdb: A lame woman may not move properly, but being other's wife she looks lovable.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਗ ਨ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਕੁਤੀਆ ਮੀਣੇ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: vag na hovan kuteeaa meene muradhaaree|

en.bdb: Bitches not being there in droves the dissemblers eat the carrion.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪਹੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਤਗੀਐ ਹੋਇ ਅੰਤਿ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit_en: paapahu mool na tageeaai hoi a(n)t khuaaree ||3||

en.bdb: Through evil actions liberation can never be attained and ultimately one becomes wretched.
